data.title: Confidently wrong: what to do
data.subtitle: Anthropic calls it hallucination. Here's the habit that catches each case.

left.label: WHAT CAN GO WRONG
items: A fact that sounds right but isn't
An old answer to a current question
"I've sent the email" when it can't
Charts skipped in a PDF over 100 pages
A guess instead of "I don't know"

right.label: WHAT TO DO INSTEAD
items: Ask where each fact came from
Ask for exact quotes with the page
Open every link before you use it
Turn on web search for anything current
Check the app: it only uses connected tools
Over 100 pages? Check the charts yourself
Tell it: say "I don't know" if unsure
